name: Scrub Out
summary: An eraser jumps out of the button and scrubs a pencil note away; Undo rewinds the writing
about: Scrub Out deletes a note the old-school way. The little pink eraser on the button wiggles, leaps out and grows, then scrubs back and forth down the index card, rubbing the pencil writing away and leaving a faint smudge and a trail of rubber crumbs. It hops back into the button, a gust blows the crumbs off the card, and Undo (or Ctrl+Z) rewinds the writing back onto the paper.
how: The mini eraser wiggles, jumps out of the button and lands on the card with a squash.
It zig-zags down the card, rubbing out each line while crumbs pile up behind it.
It hops back home and a gust of wind blows the crumbs away; the button becomes Undo.
Press Undo or Ctrl+Z within a few seconds and the writing rewinds back; otherwise it comes back by itself.
